returning: detail: likely to play after missing three games with a lower-body injury
away.summary: The Maple Leafs (8-12-2) are coming off a winless 0-6-0 homestand and have lost six straight at home. They face a depleted injury list including Max Domi, Kirill Marchenko, Marshall Rifai, Nick Blankenburg, and Colton Sissons, while Morgan Rielly is expected back after missing three games with a lower-body injury. Rookie Gavin McKenna remains in the projected lineup on the third line.

out.detail: upper body injury; will not play in either of the two remaining games on the Blackhawks' homestand

returning: detail: will play after sustaining an upper-body injury during a 5-4 shootout loss to the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday
home.summary: The Blackhawks (5-13-2) are in the middle of an Original Six Series homestand and will evaluate Bowen Byram's status after their game against Columbus on Thursday. Patrick Kane returns to the lineup after an upper-body injury. Spencer Knight is projected to start in goal, with Drew Commesso listed as the backup.
